name: Zierteich Imbiss
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Zierteich Imbiss in Tirol! Indulge in authentic Tyrolean flavors at our cozy outdoor spot near Innsbruck.
beschreibung: The entry „Zierteich Imbiss“ is listed as a snack bar in the Tyrolean region of Kitzbühel. The region around Kitzbühel is one of the best-known Alpine regions in Austria and attracts visitors from all over the world – in winter for skiing on the Hahnenkamm, in summer for hiking and cycling. Small snack bars have always been part of the local scene and provide locals and holidaymakers alike with quick, fresh snacks for a small appetite.
